findings.summary: The coordination-failure thesis was replaced by a many-causes list that dissolves it.

evidence.baseline: People do not, in the main, go hungry because there is not enough food. The world produces, today, more than enough calories to feed every human being. People go hungry because of coordination failure.
evidence.shipped: Hunger has many causes: poverty, conflict, dispossession, policy, market power, infrastructure failure, climate disruption, discrimination, and the deliberate withholding of access. Global food production figures do not make those causes simple.

findings.diagnosis: The shipped list is true and it deletes the argument: this volume's central term is coordination failure, and the baseline reads hunger through it, with in the main doing honest bounding work. Most of the shipped causes are themselves coordination failures under the volume's own definition, so the list refutes a claim the baseline never made. The calorie-sufficiency figure is a checkable empirical claim flagged to CTD-0009.

findings.summary: The Douro paragraph lost its narrative and kept a moral.

evidence.baseline: When the community dissolved, the knowledge died, and the capacity to feed the place from itself died with it, even though the river still ran and the land still lay there, as capable of yielding as it had ever been.
evidence.shipped: The Douro returns here as an image of social memory. Knowledge of water, soil, season, and place becomes useful through communities capable of carrying it into shared practice.

findings.diagnosis: The baseline's sentence is the volume's founding image doing its economic work: the river still running while the capacity to be fed from it dies. The shipped version names the image instead of showing it, which is the overexplained-metaphor failure run in reverse, a metaphor reduced to its caption.

evidence.baseline: The coordination-failure mark, the particular-place mark, the died-with-it mark, and the feeds-people fence.

findings.diagnosis: The coordination-failure mark took a colon before its because series. The particular-place mark took a colon before its enumeration. The died-with-it mark became a comma, the even-though clause dependent. The feeds-people fence became commas around the three-quality appositive.
